correctness.rationale: Conditional independent increments make the four probabilities an invertible affine encoding of m(u), m(v), m(T) in the unequal case. Subtraction of two survival mixtures gives at most four exponential terms. Division by one term and Rolle induction bound the number of distinct zeros of a nonzero such sum by three. Agreement at 0,u,v,T forces identical mixtures and positive weights and ordered rates resolve labels. For equal visits, the two values m(u),m(T) leave a local curve of solutions at every interior point: the two rate columns after row scaling span 1 and e^(−λt), which are independent across the two distinct times, so the implicit function theorem applies. For distinct times, dividing the survival Jacobian rows by te^(−αt) reduces the third independent column to a multiple of L(z)=∫₀¹ z^s ds alongside 1 and z, with z=e^(−λt); strict concavity excludes collinearity. Multinomial score information for the three independent probabilities has determinant equal to the squared probability-Jacobian determinant divided by all four probabilities. Factoring each time from the rows and then the Vandermonde from the analytic alternant gives u²v²T(v−u) times an analytic factor, whose value at zero is λ⁴ψ(ψ−1)/12 by the first-three-moment determinant. Integration gives p₁₀/u→μ₁, p₀₁/v→μ₁, p₁₁/(uv)→μ₂ with analytic positive extensions. Thus the normalized T⁸ determinant is the stated polynomial shape times a factor converging uniformly with two x-derivatives. In y=x(1−x), y²(1−4y) has its positive maximum at 1/6 with value 1/108; the two x-maxima are nondegenerate. Compactness separates their neighborhoods from the complement, strict curvature gives uniqueness in each, and reflection makes both globally maximizing for small T. A direct score-matrix computation from conditional history probabilities independently corroborated the leading coefficient at six unequal splits across two interior triples.
residual_risks: The endpoints of the uniform expansion use the continuous zero extension of the determinant to zero-length visits. The asymptotics fix the interior parameter triple and establish neither finite-sample estimation performance nor a universally optimal split for all positive budgets. The limited score calculations are numerical corroboration, not proof of uniformity.

value.rationale: Dividing a fixed monitoring budget into two cheap binary visits is an independently motivated design. Distinguishing unknown genuine and background rates makes balanced visits singular regardless of the number of independent sites, whereas deliberately unequal visits suffice without another observation type. The sharp 21.13/78.87 percent limiting split and determinant rate quantify this information tradeoff and differ qualitatively from the two-parameter no-false-alarm design. This is a concrete statistical design benchmark beyond generic mixture identifiability.
residual_risks: The optimum is local Fisher design under fixed stationary interior rates, not an ecological validation of mixture labels or a protocol robust to detection heterogeneity, setup costs, and finite-sample error.
